parameters.name: query
parameters.value: ={{ "SELECT id, productname, cf_products_shortdescriptionnew, description FROM Products WHERE productname IN (" + $('Process Order').first().json.line_items.map(l => "'" + l.product_number + "'").join(",") + ");" }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { error: { code: 'INVALID_ORDER', message: 'The order contains invalid fields.', retryable: false, requestId: $('Validate Input').first().json.requestId, details: ($json.errors ?? []).map(e => ({ issue: String(e) })) } } }}
={{ { error: { code: 'PAYMENT_METHOD_MISSING', message: 'No payment method on file for this customer.', retryable: false, requestId: $('Validate Input').first().json.requestId, details: [] } } }}

parameters.name: element
parameters.value: ={{ JSON.stringify({ id: $('Create SalesOrder').item.json.body.result.id, sostatus: "Created", cf_1311: "Payment Received in Full", cf_1283: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10), cf_1315: `payment collected via card on file (Stripe) - ${$json.body.id}` }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { error: { code: 'PAYMENT_FAILED', message: 'Payment failed.', retryable: false, requestId: $('Validate Input').first().json.requestId, details: [{ decline_code: $json.body?.error?.decline_code ?? null, raw: $json.body?.error?.message ?? 'Payment failed' }] } } }}
